therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Japanese adults with advanced Parkinson's disease on L-dopa adjunctive therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Mean change from Week 0 in Japanese UPDRS Part III total score at FAP (up to Week 24)

results.effect_size: Ropinirole PR/XR: -10.8; Ropinirole IR: -11.0; median difference 0.34 (95% CI: -1.41 to 2.09)
subgroup_findings: 30% UPDRS Part III responders at FAP: PR-PR 66%, IR-PR 69%
20% UPDRS Part III responders at FAP: PR-PR 81%, IR-PR 78%
CGI-I responders at FAP: PR-PR 63%, IR-PR 61%
Mean change in awake Off time (hours) at FAP: PR-PR -2.88, IR-PR -2.59
At Week 54 (PR-PR group only): UPDRS Part III change from baseline -12.7; 30% responders 84%; 20% responders 76%
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were infrequent and similar between arms
Neuroleptic malignant syndrome reported in 1 PR-PR subject
Cerebral infarction reported in 2 PR-PR and 1 IR-PR subjects

dose_info.dose_modifications: Down-titration over 1–4 weeks at study completion or withdrawal

context.comparator: ropinirole IR (immediate release) as active comparator in non-inferiority phase
context.duration: 54 weeks total (24-week non-inferiority phase + 8-week switching phase + 22-week long-term phase)
